statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; current evidence does not establish persistent mean-reversion failure.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON; Tail remains low overnight, while the U.S. cash open and Flash PMI form the next concentrated conditional risk window.
headline: Low overnight Tail; U.S. open and Flash PMI remain the next conditional risk window
body: The latest directly verified Nasdaq-100 futures quote available in this assessment was nearly flat after a record Nasdaq session. Fresh shared context shows broad semiconductor strength but split megacaps, while granular current NQ retracement structure remains insufficiently verified. Lower oil and subdued volatility temper Tail; rates, geopolitics and the coming U.S. event cluster keep Stress elevated.

lookbackSummary: Tail was mostly low across the prior 24 clock hours. It reached WATCH at 04:00 UTC, rose to 27% elevated at 14:00 UTC, remained WATCH at 15:00-16:00 UTC, then returned to low; Stress was predominantly extreme.
outlookSummary: Current Tail remains low because persistent mean-reversion failure is not verified. The main conditional danger window is 13:30-15:30 UTC around the U.S. cash open, Flash PMI and early post-release discovery; higher Tail there requires observed one-way continuation, shallow pullbacks or failed retracements.
